# ZAMÉ Fashion

> ZAMÉ Fashion is a Pakistani online store for premium imported women's accessories — hair clips, satin bows, headbands, crochet keychains and hair ties — founded in 2024 in Lahore, Pakistan. It sells online at https://zamefashion.com with cash on delivery nationwide, free delivery on orders over PKR 2,000, and a 7-day exchange policy.

## About

- [About ZAMÉ Fashion](https://zamefashion.com/about/): The brand story — founded in Lahore in 2024 to curate premium imported accessories (handmade crochet keychains, pearl-embellished headbands, satin bows) for women in Pakistan.
- [Contact](https://zamefashion.com/contact/): Contact ZAMÉ Fashion by email at alinawazahad@gmail.com or on Instagram @zame_fashion (https://instagram.com/zame_fashion).

## Delivery, Payment and Returns

- [Shipping & Returns](https://zamefashion.com/shipping-returns/): Delivery across Pakistan in 3–5 business days; standard delivery PKR 250, free on orders over PKR 2,000; cash on delivery (COD) available nationwide; 7-day return and exchange policy on unused items.
